profile.campus: Aligned Northern Virginia campus (Ashburn/Data Center Alley)

source.basis: Operator location page, structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

profile.reading: Aligned IAD-03 sits at 22715 Relocation Drive in Sterling, Virginia, within Loudoun County, as the third building on Aligned Data Centers Northern Virginia campus footprint alongside the earlier IAD-01 and IAD-02 facilities in nearby Ashburn. Aligned own location page for the Northern Virginia market confirms this address as part of its Data Center Alley presence, but no dedicated press release describing IAD-03 specifically, its capacity in megawatts, its square footage, or its construction or opening status could be located this session, despite a reference to a Sterling-campus announcement appearing in Aligned own machine-readable company summary file. That gap is noted honestly here rather than filled with an estimate carried over from the IAD-01 or IAD-02 buildings, since Aligned facilities vary considerably in size and specification even within the same campus. Aligned, formerly known as Aligned Energy, describes its overall footprint today as more than fifty campuses and roughly five gigawatts of contracted and available capacity across the Americas, with its Latin American operations run under the ODATA brand. Ownership of the company has shifted substantially: Macquarie Infrastructure Partners first invested in April 2018 alongside BlueMountain Capital Management, Mubadala Investment Company took a minority stake in August 2023 with Macquarie Asset Management confirmed as majority partner, CenterSquare Investment Management invested in April 2024, and Macquarie led a capital raise exceeding 12 billion dollars in January 2025. In October 2025 a consortium called AI Infrastructure Partnership, combining BlackRock Global Infrastructure Partners and MGX, agreed to acquire all of Aligned equity from Macquarie and its co-investors in a deal valued near 40 billion dollars, with a close indicated around July 2026 in Aligned own materials though not independently confirmed by a dedicated press release this session.
profile.research_note: Address confirmed via Aligned own Northern Virginia location page. reading.body:
Aligned IAD03 is the third building on Aligned's Northern Virginia campus in Sterling, within Loudoun County's Data Center Alley. The facility's power capacity, square footage, and operational status are not published, and no dedicated announcement for this site could be located despite its appearance in Aligned's own location materials. This absence of specification data means the campus cannot yet be read for its role in regional AI infrastructure.

Loudoun County hosts 326 mapped data center facilities, of which 23 operators have published power capacities totaling 1,375 megawatts across the state of Virginia. IAD03's unpublished capacity leaves its rank among published Virginia sites unknown, though Aligned's portfolio across fifty North American campuses totals roughly five gigawatts of contracted and available capacity.

The facility holds Tier III design certification, qualifying it for redundancy in power and cooling distribution but not for fault tolerance without service interruption. Without published megawatts, square footage, or opening date, IAD03 cannot be assessed for whether it will matter to AI scaling in the near term. The data needed to read this site as infrastructure simply remains closed.
